name: mortar_host

patterns.description: Drops poison/mortar danger circles mid-range. Stand still = die.
At 66% and 33% HP summons a pack (Drifters/Hounds). Clear trash while dodging mortars.

intro_notes: Final boss (~15:00). Clear trash → WARNING banner → camera punch → fight. Gold chest on kill. Chapter clear after kill.
notes: Boss 3. Artillery + summons — not a big walker. Poison pools use burn/slow statuses. Sprite placeholder: res://assets/sprites/enemies/mortar_host.png
